title: Identify the Formula
text: Friction opposes motion, so the angle between $$f$$ and $$d$$ is $$180**\circ$$. $$Thus$$ $$W=-fd$$.

title: Why the Sign Is Negative
text: $$f$$ is the friction force and $$d$$ is the distance slid. The minus sign comes from the two pointing opposite ways.

title: Interpret the Sign
text: The negative sign means friction removes energy from the block.
